How to read this report

  • The IBNR is the ultimate less the latest claims: for paid claims it includes the case reserves.
  • Mack's standard error measures the uncertainty of the chain ladder until the claims are all paid; the one-year standard error, the part that can emerge over the next year.
  • The bootstrap simulates the reserves, so its percentiles, such as 99.5%, give the reserve risk directly.
  • Figures follow the choices of the tool when the report was made: the factors, the tail and each origin's method.
